useWhen: Evaluating security of a proposed system architecture

workflow.description: Load architecture inputs and threat model. Define review scope listing containers and data flows to review
Trace end-to-end auth lifecycle for each user type. Check registration, login, session management, privilege escalation, and logout
Categorize endpoints (public, authenticated, privileged). Evaluate input validation, output filtering, rate limiting, error handling
Trace sensitive data at rest, in transit, and in use. Check encryption, logging, retention, and deletion
Evaluate security posture, data exposure, blast radius, and supply chain risks for each external service
Synthesize findings per component with severity ratings. Prioritize by threat model severity x effort

examples.input: Review security of our new SaaS architecture with Next.js, Supabase, and Clerk
examples.output: Security architecture review with per-component assessment, auth flow analysis, API security review, and prioritized remediation plan
examples.context: New product architecture before development starts

examples.input: Audit our current system's security posture
examples.output: Security assessment with findings mapped to OWASP/CWE, threat model linkage, and tech-stack-specific recommendations
examples.context: Existing SaaS product needing security review
